title: default-superclaude-to-200k
intention: A bare `superclaude` (no flags) launches at 200K by default — flip FILE_DEFAULT_200K 0→1.
why: Claude cannot self-trigger /compact, so at 1M the context balloons past Akien's notification threshold before he is alerted during heavy buildout. Defaulting to 200K makes stewardship of resources a property of the system (physics), not of anyone remembering to pass --200k (discipline). --1m still opts up for big-design stretches; command line always wins.
traces_to: Telos 6 (make life suck less / good stewardship)

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate (tester) — IOU: tester not built. Interim proof: hand-run launchers/proofs/PROOF.md (the --dry-run cases), culminating in Akien's restart measurement, filed as a VALIDATION when VALIDATIONS store exists.
falsifier.proves_red: on the next restart, a no-flag `superclaude` comes up in 200K. Wrong-intent signal: 200K chokes buildout tickets often enough (context ceilings hit mid-ticket) that the stewardship win is outweighed — the --1m escape hatch makes this cheap to test without reverting.
falsifier.horizon: re-check after a stretch of buildout work at 200K.
